question.worked_solution:
Recall that the equation of an elliptic cylinder, whose axis of symmetry is the $z$-axis, is given by

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1,
$$

and an elliptic cylinder, whose axis of symmetry is parallel to the $z$-axis and passes through the point $({x}_{0},{y}_{0})$ in the $xy$-plane, is given by

$$
\frac{(x-{x}_{0})^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{(y-{y}_{0})^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Thus, our equation is an elliptic cylinder with the following parameters:

$$
({x}_{0},{y}_{0})=(1,2),\,a=\frac{1}{5},\,b=\frac{1}{4}.
$$
